verdict.rationale: Codegen documents a REST API with full programmatic control over agent creation, execution and monitoring, plus a Python SDK (`agent.run(prompt=...)`) for advanced automation. Its API overview explicitly lists triggering agents from CI/CD pipelines when builds fail, and run-log and trace endpoints support unattended monitoring. Missing for 10: concrete CI pipeline examples (e.g., a GitHub Actions workflow), documented non-interactive or headless CLI flags (the CLI evidence centers on an interactive TUI), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
